lines.t: Blessed are the hearts that whisper, yes Lord
When the road bends and the sky turns gray
Their faith shines through every storm and shadow
The quiet strength that lights the way This is mature faith, tried and pure
Trusting is planned when the answers blur Every breath becomes a sacred song
Your will be done as the journey goes on
Blessed are the souls that pray your will be done
They rest in truth when the battle runs long
Hope stands firm in the unseen promise
Great trust born and the waiting's come
This is mature faith, deep and still
Rooted in peace, in His will Every day they walk in grace untold
Amen, Lord, through both heat and cold
Blessed are those who understand Him For they know that I am who I am
remains no fear can break this steady song peace eternal carries them strong
this is mature faith full and free living in light to every degree at all times and every season and word
Blessed are they who have truly heard Faith matured by surrender and fire
Peace refined by hearts that aspire And knowing in their spirits rise
Mature faith eternal where truth abides
Thank you.
Thanks for watching!
